tips.text: Kill every Demolisher and stay long, on Steel Path if you can; 360 Vessel Capillaries comes fast and buys the blueprint.
Hold your Capillaries until they cover everything you still need across Dante, Ruvox and Onos; a later drop can duplicate a purchase.
Bring armor strip and damage buffs; Demolishers stack damage reduction.
Bring Volt, Banshee (her 3 disables Demolisher abilities), Wukong, Mesa, Xaku or Khora; Radiation hits the Necramech Demolishers hard.
Restart after the early B rounds instead of waiting for conduits to fall, or hold past round 4 and let 2-3 fall each round for B every round.
Run Armatus in a public squad or a premade; either works.
Skip the Incarnon evolutions; rank 30 is enough for Mastery.
Players call this one of the kindest farms in the game; steady squads had Dante plus both weapons in two to three hours of Steel Path.
